title: Job seeking
reading: Although unemployment is low in Norway, there can still be strong competition for vacant jobs. If you want to work, you have to actively search for a job. It is important to use your contacts and network and show that you are interested in working. When you find a job that you would like to apply for, you will probably have to submit an application and a CV.

The application is a letter where you write a little about yourself and your background. The CV is a document where you briefly describe your work experience and education. The application and CV should be written in correct Norwegian. All the information you provide must be correct. It is important that the documents are easy to follow.

An employer who is going to hire a new employee will place emphasis on the person being the most suitable one for the job. He or she will also naturally consider whether the person in question has the right education or qualifications, but other things are also important.

Before an employer decides who is going to get the job, they will normally call applicants in to one or more interviews. At the interview, the person who has applied for the job has the chance to present him or herself and the person responsible for hiring will get an impression of the applicant. Both of them can ask questions.
discussion: Talk together Are written applications important in your home country? Discuss what a written application should contain. What are good things to ask about at an interview, and what should you avoid asking about? Discuss what you should wear at an interview. GettyImages GettyImages
exercises: Select the right answer What is a job application? A letter to the employee setting out information about the job and pay level. A letter to the employer setting out information about yourself and your background. A letter to the municipality stating that you have got the job so that they can register the employment relationship. Select the right answer What is a CV? A document where you briefly describe your work experience and education. A document where you briefly describe why you want the job. A document from a previous employer that states what you are like as an employee. Select the right answer Who can ask questions at a job interview? Only the employer, to find out about the applicant. Only the applicant, to find out more about the employer. Both the applicant and the employer. Select right or wrong Read the statements. What is right? What is wrong? There is not a lot of competition for jobs in Norway. Right Wrong A firm handshake and eye contact are important at a job interview. Right Wrong In Norway, employers only look at what education you have. Right Wrong It is common to go to one or more interviews before you are hired. Right Wrong A CV is a letter where you set out information about yourself and your background. Right Wrong Select right or wrong Read the statements. What is right? What is wrong? It is important to use contacts and networks when you are looking for a job. Right Wrong There is a lot of unemployment in Norway. Right Wrong An employer who is going to appoint a new employee looks at applicants’ education, experience and personality. Right Wrong It is a good idea to think about what kind of clothes you wear to a job interview. Right Wrong It is important that the CV and application are written in correct Norwegian. Right Wrong
teacher_notes: Lærerinnhold Tips til undervisningen Se filmen Videoen viser en kvinne sin reise fra hun finner en jobb å søke på til hun er ferdig med jobbintervju. Klippene viser kvinnen ved en datamaskin på leting etter jobber før hun sender en søknad. Så har hun et digitalt intervju. I neste klipp kan vi se at kvinnen har tatt på seg et profesjonelt antrekk. Hun går inn i en bygning og møter arbeidsgiveren, og de har et fysisk intervju. På slutten av intervjuet smiler hun og gir intervjueren et fast håndttrykk. Forslag til spørsmål Hvordan bør man oppføre seg på jobbintervju? Hvordan bør man ikke oppføre seg? Hvis ville du sett etter i en arbeidstaker hvis du var sjef? Hva ville fått deg til å tenke at en jobbsøker ikke passet til jobben? Hva tror du er lurt å skrive i en jobbsøknad? Hva bør man ikke skrive? Kan man lære noe av å dra på jobbintervju, også hvis man ikke får jobben? Hvilke råd ville du gitt til en venn som var nervøs før et jobbintervju?
